summary: Fairfax Financial's Form 6-K reports that a wholly-owned Fairfax subsidiary was declared Strategic Buyer for the Government of India's 60.72% equity stake in IDBI Bank, at INR 81 per share, totaling roughly INR 528.78 billion (about US$5.6 billion), a ~23% premium to June 30, 2026 book value under Indian Accounting Standards. Fairfax plans to contribute Digit insurance and IIFL Capital holdings into IDBI. The transaction follows the government's strategic disinvestment auction. Key risks: regulatory and central-bank approvals, foreign-ownership limits, execution of the merged financial-services model, and capital infusion requirements.
